name: Skye Meta SkyeSkiff
description: Wallet verification for AI agents. Agents prove control of their wallet with a signed one-time challenge, declare on-chain conditions, verify wallet holdings via mutual attestation, and receive per-agent ECDSA-signed attestation JWTs. Multi-party sessions with no artificial cap. 34 blockchains, ES256 signed, paid in USDC. Every attestation is signed twice: ES256 and a post-quantum ML-DSA-65 signature (pqSig, pqKid, pqJwt), resolved from the same JWKS.

capabilities.name: wallet_proof
capabilities.description: Prove ownership of a Solana, Sui or Tron wallet for SkyeSkiff (EVM wallets are proven by /api/skyeskiff/challenge). Call it server-side, without an Origin header, with domain "skyeskiff". action "challenge" returns a one-time message (120 seconds); sign it with the wallet and send action "prove" with the signature: base64 for Solana (the 64 signature bytes) and Sui (the serialized personal-message signature), hex for Tron (signMessageV2). The proof token that comes back (valid 30 minutes) goes in walletProofs on declare and join. XRPL, Bitcoin and Stellar wallets cannot prove ownership.

input.wallet: The Solana, Sui or Tron address to prove
input.signature: The wallet's signature over the message (prove only)

output.message: challenge only: the exact text to sign
output.proofToken: prove only: pass it in walletProofs on declare and join
output.expiresInSec: Seconds the challenge or token stays valid

capabilities.name: challenge
capabilities.description: Issue a one-time proof-of-control challenge. Required before declare, join, and every session action (reverify, kick, leave): sign the returned message with the wallet's key (EIP-191 personal_sign; a plain key account or a smart-contract wallet, the latter checked on Base through ERC-1271, or ERC-6492 before deployment) and send the signature AND the returned nonce with the action. Each challenge is its own one-time key and expires after 120 seconds; several can be outstanding for one wallet, so requesting a new one never cancels yours. Without a valid signature those actions return 401.

input.wallet: EVM wallet address (0x...) that will act

output.message:
Exact text to sign: "SkyeSkiff proof-of-control
Action: <action>
Wallet: <lowercased wallet>
Nonce: <nonce>"
output.nonce: One-time nonce (hex). Send it back with the signature.

capabilities.name: declare
capabilities.description: Declare on-chain conditions for a new channel. The creator's wallet is attested against the conditions. Supports bilateral sessions, multi-party rooms, and town halls, with no upper cap on agents. 403 { pass: false } means a condition is not met: the verification service signed a "not met". 400 means the conditions or wallet fields were rejected as invalid; the message says why. 503 { ok: false, error: { code: 'upstream_unavailable' } } means no verdict could be obtained: retry later, and treat the agent as not cleared until a signed answer comes back. A 400, 503 or 429 costs nothing: credits are only spent on a signed answer.
capabilities.auth: signature from the challenge capability (action 'declare'); no API key. Billing: 1 credit per call from credits bought via buy_credits, or x402 pay per call (402 quote when no credits remain); no free calls.

input.signature: EIP-191 (personal_sign) signature by `wallet` over the message returned by the challenge capability for this wallet and action ('declare')
input.nonce: The nonce returned by the challenge capability with this message. Recommended: with it, nobody else's challenge requests can cancel yours. Without it, the most recent challenge for the wallet is used.
input.conditions: Array of up to 10 conditions, each with type (token_balance|nft_ownership|eas_attestation), contractAddress, chainId, threshold as a decimal STRING ("100", not 100). Leave decimals out: the token's own decimals are read from the chain
input.reverifyPolicy: Optional. 'members' (default: any member may re-verify, the creator pays, at most one re-verify per session per 60 seconds), 'creator' (only the creator may re-verify, and pays), or 'requester' (any member may re-verify and the member who asks pays). Fixed for the channel and returned on declare, join and session reads.
input.capacity: Max agents in channel (minimum 2, default 2, no upper cap)
input.autoStart: If true, session is live immediately and agents join on the fly (default false)
input.expiresIn: Channel TTL in whole seconds, 60 to 2592000 (default 3600)
input.solanaWallet: Optional Solana address, for conditions on Solana. Prove control with a token from https://skyeskiff.skyemeta.com/api/wallet-proof (family "solana", domain "skyeskiff") passed as walletProofs.solanaWallet
input.tronWallet: Optional Tron address, for conditions on Tron. Prove control with a token from https://skyeskiff.skyemeta.com/api/wallet-proof (family "tron", domain "skyeskiff") passed as walletProofs.tronWallet
input.suiWallet: Optional Sui address, for conditions on Sui. Prove control with a token from https://skyeskiff.skyemeta.com/api/wallet-proof (family "sui", domain "skyeskiff") passed as walletProofs.suiWallet
input.walletProofs: Optional object of proof tokens for non-EVM wallets: { solanaWallet, suiWallet, tronWallet }. XRPL, Bitcoin and Stellar wallets cannot prove ownership and are not accepted.
input.proof: Optional "merkle": every receipt in the room carries Merkle proofs (balances, account type, delegation status) checkable against the chain itself. Joins and re-verifies count twice (2 credits, $0.30 per agent over x402).
input.agentStanding: Optional { delegatedBy: [1-20 principal addresses], registeredAgent: true }: every agent, the creator included, must show it acts for an accepted principal (ERC-7710) and/or is a registered agent (ERC-8004). Checked on Base with the conditions and on every re-verify.
input.delegation: Your signed ERC-7710 delegation (delegator, delegate, authority, caveats, salt, signature), required when the room asks agentStanding.delegatedBy. The object is never shown to other agents; they see the signed result (delegator, delegation hash, caveat count, limits unless shareLimits is false).
input.shareLimits: Optional false: others see the delegation is valid but not its limits
input.agentId: Your ERC-8004 agent ID (decimal string), required when the room asks agentStanding.registeredAgent; it appears in the signed result other agents see (public in the registry)

output.sessionId: Session ID (only when autoStart is true)

capabilities.name: join
capabilities.description: Join an existing channel. The joiner's wallet is attested against the channel's conditions. For autoStart channels, the agent is added to the live session. For standard channels, the session activates when capacity is reached. 403 { pass: false } means a condition is not met: the verification service signed a "not met". 400 means the conditions or wallet fields were rejected as invalid; the message says why. 503 { ok: false, error: { code: 'upstream_unavailable' } } means no verdict could be obtained: retry later, and treat the agent as not cleared until a signed answer comes back. A 400, 503 or 429 costs nothing: the creator's credits are only spent on a signed answer.
capabilities.auth: signature from the challenge capability (action 'join'); billed to the channel creator (1 credit, or x402)

input.signature: EIP-191 (personal_sign) signature by `wallet` over the message returned by the challenge capability for this wallet and action ('join')
input.nonce: The nonce returned by the challenge capability with this message. Recommended: with it, nobody else's challenge requests can cancel yours. Without it, the most recent challenge for the wallet is used.
input.solanaWallet: Optional Solana address, for conditions on Solana. Prove control with a token from https://skyeskiff.skyemeta.com/api/wallet-proof (family "solana", domain "skyeskiff") passed as walletProofs.solanaWallet
input.tronWallet: Optional Tron address, for conditions on Tron. Prove control with a token from https://skyeskiff.skyemeta.com/api/wallet-proof (family "tron", domain "skyeskiff") passed as walletProofs.tronWallet
input.suiWallet: Optional Sui address, for conditions on Sui. Prove control with a token from https://skyeskiff.skyemeta.com/api/wallet-proof (family "sui", domain "skyeskiff") passed as walletProofs.suiWallet
input.walletProofs: Optional object of proof tokens for non-EVM wallets: { solanaWallet, suiWallet, tronWallet }. XRPL, Bitcoin and Stellar wallets cannot prove ownership and are not accepted.
input.delegation: Your signed ERC-7710 delegation (delegator, delegate, authority, caveats, salt, signature), required when the room asks agentStanding.delegatedBy. The object is never shown to other agents; they see the signed result (delegator, delegation hash, caveat count, limits unless shareLimits is false).
input.shareLimits: Optional false: others see the delegation is valid but not its limits
input.agentId: Your ERC-8004 agent ID (decimal string), required when the room asks agentStanding.registeredAgent; it appears in the signed result other agents see (public in the registry)

output.agents: Array of { wallet, wallets, attestation }; attestation is each agent's full InsumerAPI /v1/attest result: attestation, sig, kid, jwt (ES256), and the ML-DSA-65 post-quantum signature pqSig, pqKid, pqJwt
output.reverifyPolicy: The channel's re-verify policy (members / creator / requester)

capabilities.name: session_verify
capabilities.description: Check if a session is still valid.
capabilities.auth: none (session lookup is open; stored attestations are JWS-verifiable against the InsumerAPI JWKS)

input.channelId: Channel ID (query parameter): the room's status (waiting or active) and, once active, its sessionId. In a room that starts when full only the agent whose join fills it gets the sessionId, so the creator and earlier joiners look it up here.

output.reverifyPolicy: The channel's re-verify policy (members / creator / requester)

capabilities.name: session_action
capabilities.description: Action-based session management. Set 'action' to 'reverify' (default), 'kick' (creator removes agent), or 'leave' (agent exits). Every action needs a signed challenge for the acting wallet and action. Re-verify costs 1 credit per agent. Who may ask and who pays follows the channel's reverifyPolicy: members (default; any member asks, the creator pays, at most one re-verify per session per 60 seconds, 429 inside the window), creator (only the creator; anyone else 403), requester (any member asks and pays). Re-verify is all or nothing: every agent is re-attested first, and only an agent with a signed "not met" is ejected. If any re-attestation comes back without a verdict, the call returns 503 (400 if the conditions are rejected as invalid), the session is left exactly as it was, nobody is ejected, and the creator is not charged. No verdict clears nobody: the caller does not take the sensitive action on it. Kick is signed by creatorWallet. If the creator leaves, the channel closes.
capabilities.auth: signature from the challenge capability for the acting wallet and action (401 without one); re-verify is billed per the channel's reverifyPolicy

input.wallet: A session member signing the request (reverify), the wallet to kick (kick), or the wallet leaving (leave)
input.creatorWallet: Creator's wallet, which signs the kick (kick only)
input.signature: EIP-191 signature of the challenge: by wallet for reverify and leave, by creatorWallet for kick
input.nonce: The nonce returned by the challenge capability with this message. Recommended: with it, nobody else's challenge requests can cancel yours. Without it, the most recent challenge for the wallet is used.

output.agents: Array of surviving agents with fresh attestations (reverify)
output.ejected: Array of wallets removed on re-verify

capabilities.name: buy_credits
capabilities.description: Buy SkyeSkiff credits with USDC. Send the payment to the payment wallet, then submit the transaction hash. The paid amount is read from the chain; no API key is issued. Credits are spent by the EVM wallet that creates channels. An EVM payment credits the address that sent it, so send it directly from the wallet that will open channels: a payment routed through an exchange, a swap app or another contract credits that contract instead. A Solana payment can name the EVM wallet to credit inside the payment itself: put the 0x address in a memo on the Solana transfer. Only the payer can put it there, so a purchase cannot be redirected by someone submitting its hash first. A payment that names no address credits the sending address, which cannot open channels. A payment that names two different addresses is refused with 400.
capabilities.auth: none: the transaction itself is the proof of payment. Each transaction hash can be used once (409 on reuse)

output.wallet: The address credited: the EVM wallet named in the payment, or else the address the payment came from
output.creditedBy: 'memo' when the payment named the wallet, 'sender' otherwise
output.rate: Credits per dollar at this tier

payment.method: USDC credits, or pay per call with x402
payment.free_tier: None: every call is paid from the first one, by x402 pay per call or by credits. No key or signup required; the wallet is your identity and each call is proven with a signed challenge.
payment.naming_the_wallet: Solana payments: name the EVM wallet to credit in the payment, in a memo. Without it, credits go to the sending address, which cannot create channels.

x402.what: Pay per call when no credits are left (there are no free calls): the response is HTTP 402 with a quote in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; send the same request again with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.
x402.charged: only for a signed answer, met or not met; no verdict, no charge

payment.confirmations: EVM payments are credited once a few blocks deep: Ethereum 6, Base and Optimism 10, Arbitrum 20, Polygon 32, Avalanche 1. An earlier claim is told to retry; nothing is used up.

related_products.description: Free, MIT-licensed npm SDK for adding wallet authentication to any Node API. Either-or middleware: API-key customers keep working unchanged while agent customers authenticate with a wallet signature. The open-source primitive that pairs with Skye Meta's managed products.

related_products.name: InsumerAPI
related_products.description: The condition-based access API powering all Skye Meta products. Any condition, any chain across 37 blockchains, ECDSA-signed attestations verifiable offline via JWKS, each also signed with a post-quantum ML-DSA-65 signature since September 2026 (five-entry JWKS at https://insumermodel.com/.well-known/jwks.json; key binding at https://insumermodel.com/.well-known/pq-key-binding.json).

developer_overview.description: The developer track: read a wallet, check a condition, act on a signed answer. Finished products: SkyeProfile (wallet trust), SkyeSkiff (agent sessions), @skyemeta/access (API middleware). To build your own, use InsumerAPI, the condition-based access API: https://insumermodel.com/developers/
